purpose: Test a lightweight actor registry outside PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0 so events can point to persons, organizations, communities, institutional groups, and social-function gaps without type collapse.
designRule: Event actors are heterogeneous; a Person reference is one actor subtype, not the universal actor container.

records.label: Nishimuraya / Eijudō
records.note: Keep outside Person Timeline. The object/process event needs the organization as an actor.

records.label: Eijudō woodcutters and printers
records.note: Do not infer individual names from the generic function.

records.label: 農村社会
records.note: Seed-level analytical group; not an exhaustive population.

records.label: 漁村社会
records.note: Regional differentiation must remain visible; no individual person inferred.

records.label: 諸藩・幕府の食料管理主体
records.note: Keep institutional actors separate from individual officials until named roles are sourced.

records.label: 都市の消費・流通主体
records.note: Analytical seed only; requires a local urban case before detailed event encoding.

schemaControls: This registry is not a replacement for PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0.
No actor record receives a personId unless it is individually verified in the Person workflow.
No organization/group is ranked or admitted to the Person collection.
